title: Justice Served After 24 Years for Noida Commissioner's Father Murder Case
summary: A murder case involving Lakshmi Singh, the father of Noida Commissioner Lakshmi Singh, has finally been resolved after 24 years. Three convicts were sentenced to life imprisonment in connection with the crime.
summary_points: Lakshmi Singh's father, Indra Dev Singh, was murdered in Noida.
The murder case went cold for over two decades before being re-investigated and solved.
Three convicts have been sentenced to life imprisonment in connection with the crime.
The case has brought closure to the family of the victim.
The investigation and prosecution were led by the Noida police.
title_hi: नोएडा कमिश्नर लक्ष्मी सिंह के पिता हत्याकांड में तीन दोषियों को उम्रकैद
summary_points_hi: नोएडा कमिश्नर लक्ष्मी सिंह के पिता इंद्र देव सिंह की हत्या हुई थी।
इस हत्याकांड में 24 साल बीत गए थे, लेकिन अब यह मामला हल हो गया है।
तीन दोषियों को उम्रकैद की सजा सुनाई गई है।
वictim के परिवार के लिए यह निर्णय एक बड़ा राहत है।
नोएडा पुलिस ने इस मामले की जांच और अदालत में प्रस्तुति की।

framing.right: Right-leaning outlets focus on the conviction of the perpetrators and the punishment they received, with some outlets also mentioning the role of the Noida police in solving the case.
